source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The telemetry test has two function expressions both named test_notification_closed. The second actually verifies dismissed events from expiry and candidate clearing. Function-expression names can repeat, so this is not a syntax error or an enforced lint rule. Name that task for passive dismissal in future edits so logs and failures identify the scenario it tests. This is a proposed scoped test-name rule, not a claim that the existing name was rejected in review.
title: Give notification test tasks different names for different removal reasons
